_about: The 29 short strings of one language (14 interface strings and 15 picture words), keyed by the names in sim/Strings.hpp (Strings::Key). Placeholders: {n} {percent} {title}.
PROVENANCE: machine-translated by a language model from English, terms aligned with the Magic Rampage Companion app, reviewed by a second model pass, NOT by a native speaker.
Native review is open (planning step 236, LEFT FOR THE OWNER). A key missing from this file shows the English one, and a placeholder that differs from the English one is refused for that key.

The seven picture.* keys (planning step 247) are machine translations too, with no native reader (LANG-1); picture.game_over is the SHORTER of two wordings, chosen only so that the phrase fits the picture's box at a readable size (tests/test_mp_overflow.cpp).

The eight picture.* and credits.* keys of planning step 248 (picture.current_score, picture.golden_score, picture.game_finished, credits.role.design, credits.role.illustration, credits.role.illustration_at, credits.role.modelling, credits.thanks) are machine translations too, with no native reader (LANG-1). picture.game_finished is the card's first paragraph only: its Facebook line stays English in the picture (an owner decision left open). A space is a place a line may break; in Japanese it is never a gap in the three picture phrases, and the credits phrases keep the spaces round their dashes.
